dialogues.speaker: Portrait Canvas
dialogues.text: (A blank canvas which will soon be used to draw a lovely picture of one of the Five Kasen.)

dialogues.speaker: Kuronushi's Likeness
dialogues.text: (Albedo's portrait of Kuronushi. The portrait has been covered up by a piece of cloth.)

dialogues.speaker: Kuronushi's Likeness
dialogues.text: (It seems like you'll only know what is on it during the unveiling ceremony itself.)

dialogues.speaker: Kuronushi's Likeness
dialogues.text: (Albedo's portrait of Kuronushi. There is no sign of any personage here. Only a backdrop adorns this image.)

dialogues.speaker: Kuronushi's Likeness
dialogues.text: (Albedo said that he wanted to leave this to everyone's imagination. Perhaps you, too, already have some clear idea of what this person might have looked like...)

dialogues.speaker: Kuronushi's Likeness
dialogues.text: (He used a special ink here to depict "Kunikuzushi," a secret that was only revealed when the canvas' surface touched water.)

dialogues.speaker: Kuronushi's Likeness
dialogues.text: (The way Ayato puts it, it seems that the person who tried to furtively search for the secret was a Fatui spy. But "who" would want to hide Kunikuzushi's past?)

dialogues.speaker: Kuronushi's Likeness
dialogues.text: (And what effect might this secret have on your own destiny?)
